query: SELECT au.name, au.email, COUNT(tt.id) as token_deductions, COUNT(ua.id) as action_count FROM app_users au LEFT JOIN token_transactions tt ON tt.userId = au.id AND tt.amount < 0 LEFT JOIN user_actions ua ON ua.appUserId = au.id GROUP BY au.id, au.name, au.email HAVING token_deductions > 0 ORDER BY token_deductions DESC LIMIT 20;
